title: Chocolate Self-Saucing Pudding

extendedIngredients.name: cocoa powder
extendedIngredients.original: 50 g cocoa powder (half for the batter, half for the topping)

steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan-forced). Grease a 1.5 litre (6 cup) baking dish and sit it on a tray lined with baking paper to catch any drips.
Melt the butter and let it cool for a minute. Whisk it with the milk, egg and vanilla extract in a large bowl until combined.
Sift the self raising flour and 25 g of the cocoa powder into the bowl, add the caster sugar and whisk to a smooth batter.
Spread the batter into the dish and smooth the top.
Mix the brown sugar with the remaining 25 g of cocoa powder in a small bowl, then sprinkle it evenly over the batter.
Boil the kettle, then slowly pour 375 ml of boiling water over the back of a large spoon held just above the pudding, covering the whole surface without denting the batter.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the top is set and springy but the sauce underneath still wobbles when you nudge the dish. Don't overbake or the sauce will dry up.
Rest for 5 minutes, then spoon into bowls and serve warm with the thickened cream.
